_doc: 0DTE research graph. Nodes: mechanism|rule|dataset|verdict-edge carrier. Edges carry evidence. Discipline: (1) a new rule node MUST link to a mechanism node with a sign prediction BEFORE testing; (2) every test edge increments its dataset's variant ledger; (3) any neighborhood mined wholesale needs a shuffled-data placebo run.

M1-afternoon-vrp.claim: 0DTE premium is overpriced in the afternoon; seller gross edge rises ~0% (open) to +12% of premium (14:00)

M2-iv-richness.claim: implied >> morning realized => selling is +EV; implied <= realized => no edge (insurance pricing)

M3-defined-risk.claim: wings cap tails structurally (math, not prediction)

M4-floor-50.claim: entry-anchored -50% premium floor; tight stops whipsaw (E-series + prod stop_loss 0% win)

M5-equal-notional.claim: sizing uncorrelated with returns; equal-notional cuts worst loss 37% (#780)

M6-settle-exit.claim: hold-to-cash-settlement pays the spread once; close1555 exits flip sign of afternoon condors

M7-execution-cost.claim: ~60% of retail 0DTE losses are spread; surviving sellers' edge ~= $0.04/leg

D1-momentum-direction.claim: mechanical directional entries (ORB 15/30/60m, momentum, pullback, confluence scores) - died OOS every form; E7 t 20.5->0.7

D2-flow-confirmation.claim: CVD / dark-pool / macro-day / entry filters add nothing or flip sign

D3-intraday-loss-detect.claim: big losers not separable from winners at entry OR in-trade (paths overlap: 47-67% of stops were green first)

D4-overnight-1dte.claim: 1DTE SPXW overnight short premium <= costs 2024-26 (16/16 cells, best t 0.46)

D5-event-straddle.claim: FOMC 13:00 long straddle: event fully priced (-8%, = controls)

D6-gex-direction.claim: GEX/VVIX as direction signal: no evidence anywhere; OI-GEX blind to 0DTE (lit)

D7-atm-fly-always.claim: unconditional ATM short vol at 10:00: -22%/day of risk

D8-premium-exits.claim: premium-mark exits whipsaw; underlying-anchored exits required for A7-class rules

R-T4-gated-condor.spec: 14:00 condor shorts +-0.15% wings +-0.6%, hold to settle, ONLY when richness >= trailing-60d median
R-T4-gated-condor.status: PASS-OOS (SPY t3.8, QQQ t4.2 stress; SPX t3.1); needs fill confirmation; vehicle XSP/SPX

R-A7-orb-sniper.spec: ORB30 score==2 long ITM 0DTE, underlying exits T15/S30/120m
R-A7-orb-sniper.status: dev-pass, holdout -2.7%, QQQ/IWM transfer fail -> mechanism-less, likely overfit

DS-spxw-0dte.note: all SPXW intraday claims; heavily mined - demand t >= ~3.5 or OOS transfer

DS-quotes-forward.note: collector NBBO; the ONLY unmined data; reserve for fill-model + confirmations

I-XSP.note: 1/10 SPX; no index data on Alpaca - SPY-proxy spot

I-SPY.note: 15:30 expiry handling blocks hold-to-settle; fine for exits<14:00

I-IWM.note: weaker on everything tested; use as 3rd transfer check only

edges.verdict: U2: gated>ungated 9/9 cells (13/14/15:00 x SPY/QQQ/SPX); peak at 14:00 matches M1 curve
U4: richness terciles cheap -2.0 / mid +4.3 / rich +17.3 (t 5.7) - monotone; EVIDENCE for M2, NOT a new threshold knob (traded rule stays at pre-registered median gate)

U3: prediction falsified - gated FOMC mean HIGHER (+22.2%) but win 58% vs 77% and worst -100%: pre-FOMC premium is rich-for-a-reason, binary. OPERATOR DECISION: skip FOMC days (tail doctrine) or accept the binary profile

U1: gate moves MEIC frictionless 0.26->0.46%/day only; base stays -0.29% (t -1.9). Cause: R-MEIC lacks M6-settle-exit - per-side stop churn pays the spread repeatedly; no entry gate can offset exit costs. MEIC shelved.
